captions.F_vn_initial: Rows x/y; columns modal reference, inverse, signed error; t=5 ms. Shared reference/inverse scales within each row.
captions.F_vn_middle: Rows x/y; columns modal reference, inverse, signed error; t=53 ms. Shared reference/inverse scales within each row.
captions.F_vn_final: Rows x/y; columns modal reference, inverse, signed error; t=100 ms. Shared reference/inverse scales within each row.
captions.F_vs_initial: Rows x/y; columns modal reference, inverse, signed error; t=5 ms. Shared reference/inverse scales within each row.
captions.F_vs_middle: Rows x/y; columns modal reference, inverse, signed error; t=53 ms. Shared reference/inverse scales within each row.
captions.F_vs_final: Rows x/y; columns modal reference, inverse, signed error; t=100 ms. Shared reference/inverse scales within each row.
captions.F_time_error: Errors against identical N40 K12 modal reference. Coarse-unprojected curve quantifies representation discrepancy, not inversion error.
captions.F_probability: Statewise PID-balanced scores and Rosenblatt 90% coverage. Fitting, selection and test particles are disjoint.
captions.F_likelihood_ray: Diagnostic-only initial-state line with full nonlinear PDE rollouts. No line value feeds checkpoint selection; reference initialization need not minimize misspecified likelihood.
captions.F_initial_scatter: Initial-field component comparison, vn left and vs right. Color encodes sample count, not probability density.
captions.F_initial_spectrum: Initial fluctuation energy in square Fourier shells; prescribed mean excluded.
captions.F_training: All-interval network training and validation objective; each curve is a fresh random initialization. Validation selects the checkpoint.
captions.F_optimization: Selected restart: full-batch fitting and disjoint-PID selection scores through all initial-control orders; not truth-based checkpoint selection.
